rationale: Third party (neighbor's child) suffered a bodily injury on the policyholder's premises due to an icy walkway condition, which is a direct liability exposure.
claim_summary: Third party (9-year-old child) sustained a broken wrist after slipping on the policyholder's icy walkway during last week's ice storm. Parents are pursuing medical claims. High severity pediatric injury requiring prompt adjuster investigation and medical record review.

case_facts.location: walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: neighbor's 9-year-old daughter slipped and fell on icy walkway
